summary: Cable One, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its MBI Term Loan Exchange Offer, which expired on June 23, 2026. The offer targeted lenders of senior secured term loans under Mega Broadband Investments Holdings LLC. Irrevocable acceptances were received from holders of approximately 34.0% of all outstanding MBI Term Loans. The company reserves the right not to consummate the exchange for any reason. This is a debt restructuring aimed at managing MBI's indebtedness. Watch for the company's decision on whether to close the exchange and implications for Cable One's balance sheet and MBI's capital structure.
